human_request: 通过以往的行情进行回测来精进判断；提高对行情的预测判断的准确性
hypothesis: Supervised joint market-level prediction can reduce next-session previous-limit-pool median-feedback error versus a fixed empirical LEVEL baseline; adding exact-session changes may or may not add value.
novelty: V272 already tested numeric quantile regression. This is a fixed rolling Ridge challenge on the official grid against V300 LEVEL median, not the first numeric regression and not a claim to beat the current production model.
baseline: LEVEL: median of known target metric levels in last120 official dates<=signal; n>=60; same V300 median definition

challengers.RIDGE_LEVEL: Fixed Ridge alpha10 on8 current levels
challengers.RIDGE_LEVEL_DELTA: same estimator on8 levels and8 exact-official-predecessor changes

estimator.imputation: training-only median with missing indicators; missing labels never imputed
estimator.all_training_column_missing: Drop that feature for that fit, record its name; no invented observed0; current missing values only imputed with learned training median

training: last120 official target dates<=signal; features on exact prior official date, target on next official date; minimum60 finite target pairs and at least one observed level per feature row
current_missing: all8 levels missing -> challenger unknown; otherwise training-only imputation recorded as statistical operation, not observed facts
features: only archived8 observations; delta on full official grid so gaps remain unknown; no emotion_state, quality score, current theme or future outcome feature
physical_bounds: V300 metric bounds; continuous points, no forced integer rounding
rolling_learning: each date may only learn labels whose target has closed by that signal date; no later labels; rolling protocol fixed now
primary_metric: paired mean absolute error on yesterday_premium, fraction units and percentage-point display
secondary_metrics: per-channel MAE, RMSE, coverage; positive-vs-nonpositive Accuracy, balanced accuracy, Precision, complete-positive Recall and F1 only for two index returns and median feedback; >0 positive, <=0 nonpositive
reference_directions: all-positive and all-nonpositive baselines on same dates; no market-wide combined Accuracy
Brier: unavailable: point regression outputs are not calibrated probabilities

uncertainty.missing_dates: retained on official grid, never compacted before block sampling

candidate_gate: Evaluation>=60 paired primary dates; lower primaryMAE and adjusted interval upper<0; no lower scoring coverage or primary direction accuracy; development primary MAE not worse. Even pass only justifies prospective confirmation, not core upgrade.
ending_condition: one fixed run with both challengers, causality/source checks and report; stop without retuning, or30minutes at a complete recoverable node
expected_improvement: test reduction in next-session factual-market forecast error, no promised percentage
data_boundary: V300 already source-checked retrospective observations; no historical theme reconstruction or new downloads; future Oct8 targets remain unknown; historical replay not forward
comparison_scope: V300 fixed research point baseline; no direct paired claim versus V272 production ecology classifier or its different folds
direction_contract: Zero-boundary positive/nonpositive tests differ from existing V272 ±0.05 quality/±0.3 index three-class targets; no pooled market accuracy
